text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Still no word...?
Don't tell me something happened—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...! Hello.
Head Butler? What is the status?

text_block_list.name: Head Butler
text_block_list.text:
"They have been born safely, Lady Rose!
Six healthy puppies...!
And of course,
the mother is doing splendidly as well!"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see... Please tend to them well.
After all, as our house's watchdog,
they have fulfilled a noble duty.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...No,
I was the one who commanded you to report
immediately regardless of the hour.
Think nothing of it.
